name: Head Of Household
overview: Scripture presents the man as the head of the household, tasked with loving and leading his family as Christ loves the church. The husband holds a position of authority over his wife, who is called to submit to him as to the Lord, while husbands are commanded to love their wives sacrificially. Fathers are instructed to nurture and discipline their children in the Lord without provoking them to anger, fostering a godly family environment rooted in love and spiritual guidance.
